Edmonton outlasts Montreal 37-30 to win 15th CFL title in franchise history
The Edmonton Elks are Grey Cup champions for the 15th time in franchise history.
Led by quarterback Cody Fajardo's four total touchdowns, two passing and two rushing, the Elks hung on to defeat the Montreal Alouettes 37-30 at McMahon Stadium in Calgary on Sunday.
The victory snaps Edmonton's 11-year championship drought.
